ValidationRule.description: To check the Madatory Data on Contact Details for Active Schemes. As per CRM-5827 included Draft Status in Error Condition Formula.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_MandatoryCheck_Active_Scheme_Contact__c && (RecordType.DeveloperName ='Public_Scheme' || RecordType.DeveloperName ='Corporate_Scheme' ) && (ISPICKVAL(Status ,'Complete – Pending Activation') || ISPICKVAL(Status ,'Active') || ISPICKVAL( Status , "Draft") ) && (ISBLANK(Title_f__c) || ISBLANK(First_Name_f__c) || ISBLANK(Last_Name_f__c) || ISBLANK(Job_Role_f__c) || ISBLANK(Email_f__c) || ISBLANK(Country_Code_f__c) || ISBLANK(Phone_Number_f__c) || ISBLANK(Mailing_Country_f__c) || ISBLANK(Mailing_Street_f__c) || ISBLANK(Mailing_City_f__c) || ISBLANK(Mailing_State_f__c) || ISBLANK(Mailing_PostalCode_f__c) || ISBLANK(Salutation_f__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please check your Key Coordinator in your asset. The below fields are mandatory for iFly: Salutation,First Name,Last Name,Job Title,Job Role,Email,Phone,Mailing Address (ensure fields are correctly filled, only street address should be in Street Address)
